entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return these absolutely worthless cycling shoes I bought. This is completely unacceptable!
I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. I can definitely look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number to start?
The name is Mark Sterling. The order number is VF88-something, I don't know! Just look it up! These shoes gave me massive blisters on my first ride. My feet are completely torn up!
I understand your frustration, Mr. Sterling. That's certainly not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just pull up your account with your name... One moment.

You'd better. I even had the cleats professionally fitted at my local shop. There's no excuse for this. If I don't get a full refund, I swear I'm going to light you up on every social media platform and cycling blog out there. Is your manager available?

I believe I can resolve this for you without needing a manager, sir. I see your order right here for the Pro-Carbon cycling shoes, delivered 13 days ago. I'm very sorry about the blisters; that sounds incredibly painful.
Let me just check the policy here. Okay, yes, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return and get you a full refund. No problem at all.
Wait, really? Just like that? A full refund?

Yes, absolutely. And since you're a VIP member and had such a terrible first experience with the shoes, I'd also like to add free expedited shipping to your next order as an apology from us at VeloFit.
Oh. Okay. Well... that's... that's actually very helpful. Thank you. I was ready for a fight.

Not at all, sir. We want to make things right. I've just sent the pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just box up the shoes, attach the label, and drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed.
Alright. I appreciate you taking care of that so quickly, Isaac. Thank you.
You are very welcome, Mr. Sterling. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
